the most efficient surveys are those that are magnitude-limited, have high observation frequency, have a deep detection limit, and are able to discover SNe in distant hosts.

The main takeaway from our work is that

the rate of subluminous SNE Ia is likely to be underestimated in magnitude-limited supernova surveys and that the rate of overluminous SNE IA is likely to be overestimated in distance-limited supernova searches.
